name: My Girlfriend Is a Witch!
source:
Mako is a middle school girl without much going on in life. But all of that changes when she finds herself embroiled in the strange world of mysterious creatures known as Witches.

A short fan-made visual novel based on the anime Madoka Magica.
translation:
真子是个平凡的初中女生，生活没有什么波澜。然而，当她卷入名为“女巫”的神秘生物所构成的奇异世界后，一切都改变了。

这是一部以动画《魔法少女小圆》为基础的短篇同人视觉小说。
